meta.name: spaghetti-monster
meta.description: Make sure to use this skill whenever the user mentions "spaghetti", "spaghetti-monster", "god object", "find tangled code", "scan for complexity", "refactor opportunities", "codebase audit", "what needs refactoring", or asks to detect, untangle, or audit high-entropy, highly coupled, non-cohesive code. The monster is a Hunter — it scans the codebase, quantifies the spaghetti, and packages each high-value target into a backlog parcel plan with Phase 1 and Phase 2 pre-populated, ready for the user to pick up Phase 3 (user clarification) in a new conversation. It does NOT execute refactors from this skill — that work happens later via pass-the-parcel execution, with the monster optionally re-invoked as a Group D sub-skill.

copy.tagline_en: Find tangled code and get a step-by-step refactoring plan.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if your codebase has tangled logic and you want a clear path to clean it up.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会扫描你指定的代码范围，找出结构混乱、纠缠不清的代码，输出一张排序问题清单，并为每个重点问题生成带两阶段预填的计划卡。它不会直接改动代码。
howto.when: 当你说出“spaghetti”“god object”“codebase audit”等关键词，或要求检测、梳理混乱代码时触发。
